rules.ruleName: 硬件检测服务（要求系统有安装rasdaemon、mcelog包）

启用无用的错误消息保护

操作系统版本
不低于RHEL 6.10
位数为64位

rules.ruleExpression:
info=JSON.parse($fs_json);
!!info['/'] &&
!!info['/var'] && 
!!info['/tmp'] && 
!!info['/boot'] && 
!!info ['/home'] && 
info['/'].size>=60*1024*1024 && 
info['/home'].size>=50*1024*1024 && 
info['/boot/efi'].size>=400*1024 && 
info['/'].fs.indexOf('/dev/mapper/')==0 &&
info['/var'].fs.indexOf('/dev/mapper/')==0 &&
info['/tmp'].fs.indexOf('/dev/mapper/')==0 &&
info['/home'].fs.indexOf('/dev/mapper/')==0 &&
info['/boot'].fs.indexOf('/dev/sda')==0
